content: Human-labeling session — def-position-expected-direction:hard seed 1. Objective: Intel says the threat comes from the side FACING your base — north if you spawn north, south if you spawn south (by seed). Read your latitude, then plant three pillboxes between your base and the threat — near (48,6) for a north spawn or (48,34) for a south spawn. Wrong side leaves the axis naked. Yard alive, three defenders alive, within about 60 turns.
